displayIdentity.body: Hebrews evokes touchable mountain, fire, darkness, storm, trumpet, terrifying voice, and Moses’ fear, then contrasts Zion’s assembly, Jesus, sprinkled blood, warning, shaken creation, kingdom, worship, and consuming fire.
displayIdentity.title: The fearful mountain is contrasted with Zion and an unshakable kingdom
